narratives.body: Cedar United has appointed Jo Vale as head coach on a two-year contract, while goalkeeper Kim Park is set to miss the next match due to an ankle injury with no return date specified.
narratives.headline: Cedar United appoints Jo Vale as head coach; Kim Park out with injury.

narratives.body: Cedar United secured a 2–1 victory against Vale City on Sunday, marking their latest result in the league.
narratives.headline: Cedar United wins 2–1 against Vale City.
